sampling.band: a candidate block is accepted only if its lateral sample deviation is within 0.62..1.45 x the model's own (the central 90% for this sample size)

quotes.recoil.recoil_determinism: The single most load-bearing finding for this port, and well corroborated from two independent angles. CoD recoil is NOT a fixed learnable spray pattern like CS:GO: it is bounded randomness with a repeatable central tendency. Implement as kick_v = rand(minV, m
quotes.recoil.recoil_recentering_behaviour: Answers "does the view return fully to point of aim" — yes, but only once firing stops, and it is a RATE not a timer. Center speed takes effect immediately on firing, so recentering competes with the next shot kick rather than waiting for trigger release. Duri
quotes.recoil.ads_bullet_spread_degrees: 0 degrees = 0 rad. Hard zero, corroborated three ways: almost all non-shotgun weapons have NO random spread while aiming down sights — shots land at precisely the point indicated by the sights. Documented exceptions: Vanguard and WWII shipped with ADS bloom, w

recoil.formula: per round: one uniform vertical draw in [vMin,vMax] and one uniform horizontal draw in [hMin,hMax], both scaled by the ADS factor; per 1/60 s tick: kick += (previous aim point - kick) * (1 - exp(-centreSpeed/60)); rounds leave on the first tick at or after k * 60/682 s. Aim is read before the round's own kick. Spread contributes nothing: recoil.ads_bullet_spread_degrees is 0 with a tolerance of exactly 0.

velocity.provenance: synthesised from targets.mjs keys [movement.base_walk_speed_legacy_iw, movement.sprint_speed_scale, movement.crouch_speed_mw3, movement.air_control, physics.gravity, physics.jump_initial_velocity, physics.slide_max_speed_scale, physics.slide_max_duration, physics.multiplayer_server_tick_rate] — NOT a recording from a shipped title
velocity.formula: walk 4.83 m/s, sprint 4.83 x 1.5 = 7.245 m/s, crouch 2.4 m/s; slide entry 4.83 x 1.55 = 7.487 m/s decaying at ln(7.487/2.4)/0.65 = 1.7502 /s so that it lands on the crouch speed after exactly 0.65 s; jump v0 6.345 m/s under 20.32 m/s^2, semi-implicit on the 1/60 s grid; airborne horizontal speed constant; ground move is friction-then-accelerate capped at the stance target.

quotes.movement.air_control: NO NUMERIC sv_airaccelerate / g_airAccelerate default exists for CoD in anything either pass could reach. A dedicated query returned only Counter-Strike values (sv_airaccelerate 10, CS:GO/CS2 12), which MUST NOT be borrowed for CoD — that borrowing is the spec

quotes.damage.m4a1_mw2019_ttk_max_range: 264 ms, +/-25 ms (~10%), absorbing the first-bullet convention and the +/-2% RPM band. quotes.ballistics.instant_hit_range_formula_div: Warzone servers run a 20 Hz tick, so any target inside (velocity / 20) metres resolves within a single tick and the projectile is indistinguishable from hitscan. The divisor is EXACT (hence abs: 0); only the per-weapon derived instant-hit radius needs slack, a

ttk.formula: 30 HP flat to 37.5 m, linear to 20 HP at 50 m, flat beyond; 100 HP target; rounds on the first tick at or after k * 60/682 s; the first 37.5 m (= 750/20) resolves on the trigger tick and the remainder flies at the muzzle velocity, arriving on the first tick at or after; TTK = fatal arrival - first arrival.
